what_happened: Compile-verified the plan's Lean Challenge Statements block against the repo toolchain before returning: all 14 pinned signatures and both schema def bodies type-check (only the 9 sorry-bodied theorems warn). Caught nothing broken, but converts the statement contract from asserted to measured.

Declared file_scope for task 911 was LadderPump.lean alone, but exists_ladderPath_of_walk_nxt_at (the only register-anchoring lift) lives in LadderChain.lean, DOWNSTREAM of LadderPump. The schema's nxtAt g' z = nxtAt g z clause is therefore unreachable from the declared scope. Plan adds a new leaf module LadderIdle.lean plus the generated-surface chain; per-phase Files to modify is now the authority and the harvest will widen file_scope from 1 to 10 paths.

LadderPump.lean stands at 1485 lines with NO longFile baseline, so the first added line crosses the 1500 ceiling and CI's --wfail turns that lint into a hard failure. Scheduled the baseline in phase 1 and a per-phase re-check of the N-200 <= lines < N acceptance window, plus a final re-tighten in phase 7.

Phase 1 plan step asked for a section variable block; Lean 4's use-based variable inclusion would have added [Fintype Q] to no_consecutive_idle_of_no_idle_step, contradicting its Challenge-pinned signature. Wrote binders per declaration instead; signatures match the Challenge block exactly.

deriving Fintype on a 3-constructor inductive fails to elaborate on Lean v4.33.0-rc1 in this project (generated membership proof: 'Application type mismatch: QI.enumList_nodup has type QI.enumList.Nodup but is expected to have type (coe QI.enumList).Nodup'). Worked around with a hand-written Fintype instance.

The general parity lemma idleRun_even (every idle run on the witness object has even length) replaced the planned position-by-position 5-step object chain in the refutation: one induction on the run index plus three decide-closed table lemmas, and the refutation then closes in one line from 5 % 2 = 0.
